signInCodeEmail.subject: Your {product} sign-in code: {code}
signInCodeEmail.text:
Your {product} sign-in code: {code}

The code is valid for {minutes} minutes. If you did not ask for it, ignore this email.

passwordResetCodeEmail.subject: Your Bluberi password reset code: {code}
passwordResetCodeEmail.text:
Your code to set a new Bluberi password: {code}

The code is valid for {minutes} minutes. If you did not ask for a new password, ignore this email. Your password stays as it is.

phoneCodeSms.text: Bluberi: your verification code is {code}. It is valid for {minutes} minutes.

sellerApprovedEmail.subject: Bluberi: your store is approved
sellerApprovedEmail.text:
Hello,

we have checked and approved the seller registration of {company}. Sign in to Bluberi Seller and you can start selling.

The Bluberi team

sellerDocumentsRequestedEmail.subject: Bluberi: we need more documents for your registration

sellerRejectedEmail.subject: Bluberi: we did not approve the seller registration
sellerRejectedEmail.text:
Hello,

we did not approve the seller registration of {company}.

The reason:

{message}

If you do not agree with the decision, write to us at {supportEmail}.

The Bluberi team

sellerMessageEmail.subject: Bluberi: a new message from the team
sellerMessageEmail.text:
Hello,

the Bluberi team wrote to you about the seller {company}:

{message}

You can answer in Bluberi Seller, in the section Messages.

The Bluberi team
